name: Baron's Demise
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The contract you recovered was signed by Baron Vardus, a noble of the former kingdom of Alterac, and one known for a cold heart and brutal practices.  I'm not surprised someone like the Baron was behind this.

Find this man.  Find him, and bring him to justice.  He must be among the Syndicate haunts - perhaps at the ruins of Strahnbrad, or perhaps within the valley north of them.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Head of Baron Vardus to Magistrate Maleb in Southshore.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. My head rests a little easier, knowing that villain lost his.
narrative.requestItemsText: Baron Vardus cannot think Southshore will allow him to send his thugs against us with impunity. I want his head!
